context.en: Liu Bang, at right, is the leader of the Pei uprising described here.
context.zh: 右侧的刘邦，即本条沛地起兵的领袖。

context.en: Liu Bang, at right, is the new emperor at the close of the Chu–Han war.
context.zh: 右侧的刘邦，即楚汉战争结束后称帝的新君主。

context.en: The Ming portrait names Bai Qi, commander of Qin’s army at Changping.
context.zh: 明代画像题名白起，即长平之战的秦军统帅。

context.en: The portrait represents Bai Qi, the Qin commander at Yique.
context.zh: 画像表现伊阙之战的秦军统帅白起。

context.en: Zheng Chenggong led the 1661–1662 campaign described here.
context.zh: 郑成功领导了本条所述1661至1662年的战役。

context.en: This later Binyang relief belongs to Longmen’s extended building history, about three decades after the first carving.
context.zh: 这件晚约三十年的宾阳浮雕，属于龙门长期营造历史中的后续阶段。

context.en: The 1609 printed portrait represents Li Yu, whose captivity and death are discussed here.
context.zh: 1609年刊本画像表现本条拘居及去世叙述中的李煜。
